callback_reconfigure_loss

Source: R/utilities.R
callback_reconfigure_loss.Rd

Reconfigure the unified focal loss hyperparameters at specified epochs during training.

Usage

callback_reconfigure_loss(loss, schedule)

Arguments

loss

An instantiated defineUnifiedFocalLoss or defineUnifiedFocalLossDS object. Must be the same object passed as loss to luz::setup().

schedule

A list of named lists, each specifying one reconfiguration event. Each entry must contain:

epoch

Single integer. The training epoch at the end of which the parameters are updated. The new values take effect from the following epoch onward.

params

Named list of parameter name–value pairs to update. Names must match those listed in the Details section above.

Value

A luz callback object.

Details

A luz callback that updates one or more parameters of an instantiated defineUnifiedFocalLoss or defineUnifiedFocalLossDS loss object at defined epoch boundaries. Because torch nn_module objects are reference types, the same object passed here is used by the luz training loop, so changes applied by the callback take effect immediately for the following epoch.

For defineUnifiedFocalLossDS, parameters are routed to the inner defineUnifiedFocalLoss sub-object automatically.

Parameters that have pre-computed tensor counterparts (see Details) have both the scalar field and the corresponding tensor updated atomically so that the forward pass always reads consistent values.

The following parameters may be reconfigured:

lambda

Relative weight of distribution vs. region loss.

gamma

Focal weighting strength.

delta

False positive / false negative balance (scalar or per-class vector).

clsWghtsDist

Class weights for the distribution loss (scalar or per-class vector).

clsWghtsReg

Class weights for the region loss (scalar or per-class vector).

smooth

Smoothing constant for numeric stability.

distThreshold

Distance threshold for edge weighting.

minWght

Minimum per-pixel edge weight.

maxWght

Maximum per-pixel edge weight.

useLogCosH

Toggle log-cosh transform on the region loss.

labelSmoothing

Label smoothing factor for the distribution loss.

classAvgDist

Switch between macro-averaged and pixel-level distribution loss.

prioritizeEdge

Flip which pixels receive the higher edge weight.

edgeMode

Edge weighting mode: "threshold", "linear", or "gaussian".

applyDistWght

Which loss component receives edge weights: "distribution", "region", or "both".

cropFactorMsk

Mask crop factor.

cropFactorPred

Prediction crop factor.

zeroStart

Whether class indices start at 0.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
loss_fn <- defineUnifiedFocalLoss(nCls = 3, lambda = 0.5, gamma = 0.5, delta = 0.6)

reconfigure_cb <- callback_reconfigure_loss(
  loss = loss_fn,
  schedule = list(
    list(epoch = 5,  params = list(lambda = 0.7, gamma = 0.3)),
    list(epoch = 10, params = list(lambda = 0.9, clsWghtsDist = c(1, 2, 3))),
    list(epoch = 15, params = list(labelSmoothing = 0.1))
  )
)

fitted <- model |>
  luz::setup(loss = loss_fn, optimizer = torch::optim_adamw) |>
  luz::fit(train_dl, epochs = 20,
            callbacks = list(reconfigure_cb))
} # }
